faqs.a1: Je zuwa ododinku don bin diddigin matsayin isarwa. Yawancin oda suna isa cikin lokacin da aka nuna yayin biyan kuɗi.
faqs.q2: Yaya zan fara mayar da kaya?
faqs.a2: Kuna iya fara mayar da kaya cikin kwanaki 15 bayan an isar da su daga shafinku na ododi. Tabbatar cewa kayan suna cikin yanayinsu na asali.
faqs.q3: Waɗanne hanyoyin biyan kuɗi ake karɓa?
faqs.a3: Muna karɓar katunan kuɗi, tura kuɗi ta banki, da walat na wayar hannu ta hanyar abokan hulɗar biyan kuɗi masu aminci.
faqs.q4: Ta yaya zan iya kare asusuna?
faqs.a4: Yi amfani da kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi, kunna sanarwa, kuma kada ku raba lambobin sirri na lokaci ɗaya. Tuntuɓi taimako nan da nan idan kun ga wani abu da ba ku amince da shi ba.

about.title: Game da GloTrade
about.intro: GloTrade shago ne na intanet a Afirka wanda GloTrade ke mallaka da gudanarwa, yayin da NEXGEN TECH INNOVATIONS LIMITED ke bunkasa tare da kula da dandalin.
about.story1: An kafa GloTrade ne don bai wa abokan ciniki damar samun ingantattun kayan asali cikin sauki da tsaro.
about.story2: Mun gina GloTrade a matsayin shago na kai tsaye don tabbatar da ingancin kaya da saurin isarwa.
about.story3: A yau, GloTrade tana sayar da ingantattun kayayyaki na asali tare da isar da su cikin aminci ga abokan ciniki a duk fadin kasar.
about.missionText: Ƙarfafa kasuwancin Afirka da mabukaci tare da dandali na e-commerce mai aminci da ƙira.
about.visionText: Zama babban shagon intanet mafi aminci a Afirka.
about.value1Desc: Kowane ciniki a GloTrade yana da kariya. Muna tabbatar da masu sayarwa.
about.value2Desc: An gina a Afirka, don Afirka. Muna tsara dandalinmu bisa ga gaskiyar Afirka.
about.value3Desc: Muna imani da ƙarfafa ƴan kasuwa na gida da haɗa al'ummomi.
about.value4Desc: Daga shirin GDIP zuwa dandalin da ke da harsuna da yawa, muna ci gaba da ƙirƙira.
about.value5Desc: Babu kuɗaɗen da aka ɓoye. Manufofi bayyananne da sadarwa a bude.
about.value6Desc: Muna girma sa'ad da masu amfani namu suka girma.
about.gdipDesc: GDIP shine shirin tabbatarwa da inshorar masu siyarwa na GloTrade.

privacyPolicy.title: Manufar Tsare Sirri
privacyPolicy.lastUpdated: An sabunta na ƙarshe: 1 ga Satumba, 2026 · Yana aiki daga: 1 ga Satumba, 2026
privacyPolicy.intro: A GloTrade (tare da fasahar da NEXGEN TECH INNOVATIONS LIMITED ta kera kuma take kula da ita), sirrinku yana da mahimmanci.
privacyPolicy.sec1Txt1: Lokacin da kuka yi rajista ko siyan abu, muna karɓar sunanku, imel, lambar waya, adireshin isar da sako, da bayanan biyan kuɗi.
privacyPolicy.sec1Txt2: Muna tattara bayanan shafukan da kuka duba, bincike, nau'in na'ura, lambar IP, da lokacin da kuka shiga shafin.
privacyPolicy.sec1Txt3: Muna ajiye tarihin siyayya, sayarwa, mayar da kaya, da sauran mu'amaloli don ba ku cikakken sabis.
privacyPolicy.sec2Txt1: Don sarrafa oda, karɓar biyan kuɗi, tura kaya, da taimaka muku a matsayin abokin ciniki.
privacyPolicy.sec2Txt2: Don ƙirƙira da kula da asusunku na GloTrade da tabbatar da tsaro.
privacyPolicy.sec2Txt3: Don aiko muku da sakon tabbatar da kaya, labaran tura kaya, da sanarwa masu mahimmanci.
privacyPolicy.sec2Txt4: Don bincikar yadda ake amfani da dandalinmu da kuma gyara kura-kurai don sauƙaƙe muku amfani.
privacyPolicy.sec3Txt1: Muna tura bayanan biyan kuɗi zuwa ga abokan hulɗar biyan kuɗi masu aminci. Ba ma ajiye bayanan katinku a sabar mu.
privacyPolicy.sec3Txt2: Muna ba kamfanonin jigilar kaya adireshinku da lambar wayarku don kawai isar da kayanku.
privacyPolicy.sec3Txt3: Muna iya bayyana bayanku idan doka ta buƙata ko don kare lafiyar masu amfani da dandalinmu.
privacyPolicy.sec3Txt4: BA MA sayarwa ko ba da hayar bayananku ga kowa don tallace-tallace.
privacyPolicy.sec4Txt1: Duk bayanan da ke tsakanin na'urarku da sabar mu ana karesu da tsarin TLS.
privacyPolicy.sec4Txt2: Ma'aikatan da aka ba izini ne kawai ke iya duba bayanan sirrinku.
privacyPolicy.sec4Txt3: Muna gudanar da binciken tsaro akai-akai don tabbatar da cewa dandalinmu yana da cikakken tsaro.
privacyPolicy.sec5Txt1: Kuna iya neman kwafin bayananku da muke da su a kowane lokaci.
privacyPolicy.sec5Txt2: Kuna iya gyara bayananku a cikin sashen saitunan asusunku ko ta tuntuɓar mu.
privacyPolicy.sec5Txt3: Kuna iya buƙatar a goge bayananku idan babu wata doka da ta hana hakan.
privacyPolicy.sec5Txt4: Kuna iya daina karɓar saƙonnin talla a kowane lokaci.
privacyPolicy.sec6Txt1: Wadanda suka zama dole don dandalin ya yi aiki yadda ya kamata.
privacyPolicy.sec6Txt2: Suna taimaka mana mu fahimci yadda ake amfani da shafin.
privacyPolicy.sec6Txt3: Kuna iya saita browser ɗinku don sarrafa yadda kuke son amfani da cookies.
privacyPolicy.sec7Txt: Za mu iya sabunta wannan manufar lokaci zuwa lokaci. Za mu wallafa duk wani sabon canji a wannan shafin.

termsOfService.sec8Txt3: GloTrade ba za ta biya diyya kan asarar da ba ta kai tsaye ba.
termsOfService.sec9Txt1: Dole ne a fara neman sulhu ta sashen dandalinmu kafin zuwa kotu.
termsOfService.sec9Txt2: Wadannan sharuɗɗan suna karkashin dokokin Tarayyar Jamhuriyar Nijeriya.
termsOfService.sec10Txt1: Kuna iya rufe asusunku a kowane lokaci ta tuntuɓar tallafi.
termsOfService.sec10Txt2: Muna da ikon dakatar da asusun da ya keta wadannan sharuddan.

shippingPolicy.title: Manufar Aika Kaya da Isarwa
shippingPolicy.lastUpdated: An sabunta na ƙarshe: 1 ga Satumba, 2026 · Yana aiki daga: 1 ga Satumba, 2026
shippingPolicy.intro: GloTrade ke shirya da tura kaya kai tsaye daga rumbun ajiyarta da ke Lagos da Abuja.
shippingPolicy.sec1Txt1: Ana shirya oda cikin kwanakin aiki 1–2 bayan tabbatar da biya (Litinin zuwa Jumma'a).
shippingPolicy.sec1Txt2: Odar da aka yi bayan 2:00 PM (WAT) za a fara shirya ta a ranar aiki ta gaba.
shippingPolicy.sec1Txt3: Za ku karbi sakon bibiyar kaya da zarar kayanku sun fito daga rumbun ajiyarmu.
shippingPolicy.sec1Txt4: Lokaci na iya ƙaruwa a lokutan bukukuwa ko manyan rangwame.
shippingPolicy.dom5Zone: Kudu Maso Gabas / Kudu Maso Kudu
shippingPolicy.domNote: * Ana lissafa lokaci ne daga ranar da kaya suka fito, kuma kudin zai bayyana a wurin biya.
shippingPolicy.sec3Intro: GloTrade na tura kaya zuwa wasu kasashen Afirka da sauran kasashen duniya.
shippingPolicy.customsWarning: Ana iya karɓar harajin kwastam a kan kayan da aka aika waje wanda mai siya zai biya.
shippingPolicy.track1: Za ku karɓi sakon bibiyar kaya kai tsaye bayan an tura kayan.
shippingPolicy.track2: Kuna iya duba halin da kayanku ke ciki a cikin shafin Ododina.
shippingPolicy.track3: Tuntube mu idan ba a sabunta bayanin bibiya ba bayan kwanaki 5 na aiki.
shippingPolicy.sec5Title: Kayan da Ba a Isar Ba ko Suka Bace
shippingPolicy.sec5Txt1: Mai kawo kaya zai yi ƙoƙari sau 2 zuwa 3 kafin ya mayar da kaya ga mai sayarwa.
shippingPolicy.sec5Txt2: Da fatan a duba adireshinku da kyau kafin yin oda; ba ma ɗaukar alhakin kuskuren adireshi.
shippingPolicy.sec5Txt3: Idan kamfanin jigila ya tabbatar da cewa kaya sun bace, za mu biya kuɗinku ko maye gurbin kayan.
